title: Accountability leaderboard
lede: The late-return board now tells the truth about overdue gear, keeps filters in the URL, and lets you find yourself without leaving the ranking.

stats.n: Nolan’s on-time rate dropped once currently overdue checkouts count as not on time. Same live inventory, same 2026-27 year.

sections.heading: Leaderboard
sections.note: Cursor IDE Chromium, 1372×1160 CSS pixels (PNGs 2744×2320), ADMIN, dark, authenticated Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000. Before is the loaded page on HEAD f7733f57 before this patch. After is the same HEAD plus accountability patch 10299c19. After URL is /accountability?year=2026 because year now persists; that is an intended change, so this is not a hash-validated pair.

shots.title: Loaded leaderboard before
shots.cap: Rank by Volume / Time / Recent. Return records of 69% and 80% sit next to 1 checkout overdue now. No search, no You’re #N, red badges on resolved rows too, RANK 1/2/3 labels on the podium.

shots.title: Loaded leaderboard after
shots.cap: Rank by Events / Time / Latest. Find a person and You’re #12 sit in the toolbar. Nolan is 64%, Trey 76%. David’s count is a quiet gray 4 because the gear is back. Podium reads 1st / 2nd / 3rd.

sections.heading: Find yourself
sections.note: After-only: the signed-in jump and local search did not exist on the baseline. Same viewport, role, and live 2026-27 inventory.

shots.title: You’re #12
shots.cap: You’re #12 jumps to Erik Role. The row keeps rank 12, shows a You badge, 92% return record, and 1 checkout overdue now. Sticky header stays put while the list scrolls.

shots.title: Person search
shots.cap: Search Erik filters the table to one row without changing the spotlight, metrics, or excluded-record count. Rank 12 is preserved.

sections.heading: Receipts
sections.note: After-only. The intended before-receipts capture was lost (a Settings page was saved in that slot and discarded). Do not treat this as a matched pair.

shots.title: Incident history
shots.cap: Expanded history leads with the live overdue checkout. Exclude is a labeled button. Dates and late duration sit in the meta row, not as extra badges.

changes.was: Return record used completed checkouts only, so a person with overdue gear could still show 100% or a high green bar.
changes.now: After three episodes, on-time rate is on-time completed checkouts divided by completed plus currently overdue PERSON checkouts. Open overdue work counts as not on time.

changes.was: Year, location, incident state, user state, and sort lived only in React state, so a refresh or shared link reset the board.
changes.now: Those filters sync to the query string. The current academic year is written as year=2026 when it is selected. Person search stays local and does not change rank, metrics, or the spotlight.

changes.was: Eighteen rows and no way to jump to the signed-in viewer.
changes.now: You’re #N jumps to the row. A You badge marks it. Find a person filters the table in place.

changes.h: Red means gear is still out
changes.was: Every late-event count used a red badge, including All returned rows.
changes.now: Red badges are reserved for people who still have overdue gear. Resolved counts stay quiet gray.

changes.was: Export ranking assigned window.location and navigated away.
changes.now: ADMIN CSV downloads in place through the shared report-export path. Rate limit and permission run before report work.

changes.was: Rank by Volume / Time / Recent. Incident badges competed with dates. Exclude was easy to miss. Active overdue receipts could sit under resolved ones.
changes.now: Rank by Events / Time / Latest. Active overdue receipts sort first. Exclude is a labeled button. Item summaries load only for incident rows so the warm path stays under a second.

verification: Focused tests: tests/accountability-service.test.ts, tests/accountability-routes.test.ts, tests/accountability-page-source.test.ts. 32 tests across 4 files, then the page-source file again at 5/5, all pass.
eslint on the accountability page, client, spotlight, API route, and service: pass
git diff --check on those accountability paths: pass
npm run build:app: skipped. Preview was already bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; the repo guard refuses a Next compile while that port is in use.

Authenticated Preview as Erik Role ADMIN, dark appearance, /accountability then /accountability?year=2026. Live board: 18 people, 39 late events, 9 currently overdue. Nolan 64% with overdue gear; David 80% with a gray count after returns. You’re #12 lands on Erik Role at 92%. Search Erik keeps the spotlight and metrics. Exclude on FB vs Notre Dame (Neutral) is a labeled button. CSV download was exercised in-session and stayed on the page.
Warm GET /api/accountability ~761ms after the two-phase item-summary load. One later resource was ~7.3s, likely a compile, not the warm path.
notes: Receipts are after-only because the baseline capture in that slot was a Settings page and was discarded.
Before and after page shots are not a hash-validated pair: after writes year=2026 into the URL.

The before screenshot predates the accountability patch; its capture receipt was recorded later and uses the after patch hash as workspace provenance, not as proof that the before pixels came from that patch.
Unrelated dirty work (schedule activity, settings sub-pages, app chrome) was left untouched. A sidebar hydration warning from data-cursor-ref is from that other work.
Do not run npm run build while Preview occupies :3000.
Person search is local only and is not written to the URL.
